prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: six complete independently riggable SOFT anatomical attachments for the approved walking-forest mineral-turtle death animation.
Reference1 is the original neutral character and authority for head shape, spotted olive skin, pale cream jaw, short neck and chunky three-clawed feet. Reference2 is the approved folded key. Preserve this anatomy and rendering exactly; do not redraw the mountain shell or any mineral.

Create a genuinely TRANSPARENT 3-column by 2-row parts atlas. Six equal square cells, generous empty alpha gaps, one complete soft part per cell, no text/labels/grid. IMPORTANT: NO glow, colored haze, aura, fake dark background, shadow or semitransparent cloud around the attachments. Pixels outside each clean cutout are fully transparent.

Top-left: original complete round head with eyes OPEN, left-facing three-quarter camera, cream lower jaw, and the entire short thick neck extending back/right to a fully rounded root, all hidden contours drawn.
Top-middle: exact same head/neck drawing at identical scale/position/view, skull and neck unchanged, eyes gently CLOSED as approved. Do not change its pose, scale, spots or jaw between the two expression attachments.
Top-right: complete far FRONT LEG: hidden rounded shoulder, elbow, wrist, original bulky three-clawed foot, in neutral downward stance, one continuous complete articulated limb.
Bottom-left: complete near FRONT LEG: hidden shoulder root, thick upper limb, elbow/wrist and original three-clawed forefoot, neutral downward stance matching reference1. Include every hidden contour with useful joint overlap.
Bottom-middle: complete near HIND LEG: thick hip/root, knee, ankle and chunky three-clawed rear foot, neutral downward stance. Preserve original limb volume, no socket mechanism.
Bottom-right: original short cream-olive tapered upward-curved tail with a complete thick rounded root and small original tip.

Retain original brush shading, light direction, outlines and olive spot palette. All parts are complete and fully contained with clear alpha margins. Exclude ALL boulders, crystals, amber seams, plastron, shell rims, leaves, neighboring parts, detached claws, scenery, glow and ground shadows. These are real source layers for an editable local bone/mesh rig, not new full character keyframes or a poster.
